chunks: By Allah, he is not capable of solving the problems that come to him,
nor is he fit for the position assigned to him.
Whatever he does not know he does not regard it worth knowing.
He does not realize that what is beyond his reach is within the reach of others.
If anything is not clear to him he keeps quiet over it because he knows his own ignorance.
Lost lives are crying against his unjust verdicts,
and properties (that have been wrongly disposed of) are grumbling against him.
ai.seo_question: What are the signs of an unfit judge or leader according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) identifies the core defect of unfit judges as their failure to recognize the limits of their own knowledge, leading them to issue rulings on matters beyond their comprehension while remaining silent on complex issues due to self-awareness of their ignorance. This passage, found in the section on judicial appointments, underscores the Shia emphasis on *'adl* (justice) requiring not just legal authority but deep jurisprudential insight (*fiqh*) and humility. The metaphor of blood crying out and inheritances revolting illustrates the cosmic and social consequences of judicial error, linking personal spiritual deficiency to public injustice.
